text: The Acting President, Toronto Parking Authority, will give a presentation on Toronto Parking Authority Strategic Focus and Transformation Update for the Nine Months Ended September 30, 2019.

The Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Requested the President, Toronto Parking Authority, to prepare a Work Plan on technology for Toronto Parking Authority's "Strategic Initiatives", as outlined in the presentation from the Acting President, Toronto Parking Authority, and to report to the Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority at its meeting on March 24, 2020.
